description_excerpt: Overview Role: Senior Manufacturing Engineer Develops process and production line capability to support end-to-end manufacture or fabrication of products, components, sub-assemblies, and/or final assemblies. Reviews both internal and external component/sub-component/device specification sheets and shares them to key stakeholders. Applies expertise through the use of predictive modeling techniques to inform manufacturing process design choices for a product, part, component, sub-assembly, or final assembly.
